messages:
OpsBot: INCIDENT ALERT: high GPU queue in prod-east-1 (automated pager). autoscaler failing to provision new GPU nodes. impact: request queue length > 120, several customer timeouts. Paging oncall. :rotating_light:
Jordan (Oncall): I'm on it. Observability shows GPU pool at 100% and cluster-autoscaler logs show repeated scale-up attempts that time out.
Alex (SRE): grabbing cluster-autoscaler logs now. can someone paste the ASG limits?
Sam (Infra): ASG gpu-prod-east-1-worker max=12 current=12, min=4. We have no free capacity in region. autoscaler tried to increase but EC2 Launch failed: instance profile attach error.
Rita (MLOps): customers seeing 503s from inference API and increased tail latency. I can throttle internal batch jobs to claw back tokens but need nodes asap.
Jordan (Oncall): Alex, paste logs please.
Alex (SRE): logs: ```
I0305 14:03:21.123456 1 kube_client.go:256] No nodes available for upcoming pod
I0305 14:03:21.789012 1 aws_manager.go:412] Launching instance failed: CreateFleet failed: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform this operation
caused by: instance profile iam:PassRole denied for role arn:aws:iam::XXX:role/Redwood-GPU-NodeRole
```
Alex (SRE): autoscaler attempted to create node with launch config "gpu-nodes-v3" but EC2 returned UnauthorizedOperation.
Sam (Infra): hmm — looks like the new nodegroup's instance profile is missing passrole permission or our control-plane role lost iam:PassRole to attach instance profile. I just checked the instance profile binding: it points to role gpu-node-role-v2. Policy review shows an inline deny on iam:PassRole that was deployed in a policy rollout earlier today.
Maya (Product): customer impact estimate? which tenants affected?
Rita (MLOps): We have 7 active customer inference pipelines queued; top 3 are high-priority paying customers (acct: acme, polysoft, devkit). They are seeing ~30-60s extra latency, some 504s. I've opened support holds to inform them.
Jordan (Oncall): mitigation plan: (1) temporarily scale ASG manually by increasing max and add nodes via console? (2) create bootstrap nodes using non-GPU instance type to drain queue? (3) revert the policy change that added deny? Which is quickest?
Sam (Infra): quickest is manual ASG increase with an alternate launch template that uses the older instance profile (gpu-node-role-v1) which still has passrole. I can flip the ASG to use that LT and request immediate scale to +3.
Alex (SRE): downside: older LT has a different taint key set. New nodes will come up with taint "redwood/gpu_reserved=true:NoSchedule" while autoscaler expects "gpu.redwood.com/reserved=true:NoSchedule"; we'll need a small K8s admission patch or a post-start job to rename taint to register correctly.
Rita (MLOps): can we instead spin up a few standard cpu nodes and run lower-precision models there as temporary fallback? Would reduce quality but keeps customers alive.
Jordan (Oncall): do both in parallel. Sam do ASG swap; Alex prepare a DaemonJob that runs on new nodes to mutate taints and label them for the gpu scheduler. Rita prepare inference fallback config and switch traffic for top customers.
Sam (Infra): executing ASG update now. ```aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-prod-east-1-worker --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abc123,Version=2 --min-size 4 --max-size 15``` -> request accepted, increasing desired to 15.
OpsBot: AUTO: ASG desired capacity increased from 12 to 15 (by Sam).
Alex (SRE): patch ready: ```
kubectl -n kube-system apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: taint-normalizer
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: p3.*
      containers:
      - name: fix
        image: bitnami/kubectl:latest
        command: ["/bin/sh","-c","for n in $(kubectl get nodes -o name | grep gpu); do kubectl taint nodes ${n##*/} gpu.redwood.com/reserved=true:NoSchedule- || true; kubectl taint nodes ${n##*/} redwood/gpu_reserved=true:NoSchedule- || true; kubectl label nodes ${n##*/} gpu.redwood.com/normalized=true; done"]
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
EOF
```
Sam (Infra): new instances are in pending -> running. I see EC2s launching with lt-0abc123 and role gpu-node-role-v1. Instance bootstrap logs show kubelet registering but CNI failing briefly; nodes are NotReady.
Alex (SRE): give it a minute, kube-proxy and cni will settle. I'll watch pods scheduling.
Rita (MLOps): started traffic reroute for acme and polysoft to fallback smaller models; devkit on standby. Switching routing now.
OpsBot: NOTE: support ticket #78921 created for affected customers.
Jordan (Oncall): status update in 10. Anyone seeing queue shrink?
Alex (SRE): two new nodes joined and became Ready. taint-normalizer job ran and fixed taints on one. scheduler placed 18 pods onto new capacity, queue reduced from 122 to 38 in ~6 minutes. tail latency back to 95th ~420ms from 1.8s.
Rita (MLOps): fallback is working for the two top customers; they report degraded quality but endpoints healthy.
Sam (Infra): follow-up: I'm rolling back the inline policy deny and will open a PR to restrict the deny to the staging account only. Also will reconcile launch templates so autoscaler uses a launch template that has correct instance profile and taint metadata.
Maya (Product): thanks team. keep customers informed and coordinate postmortem.
Jordan (Oncall): incident -> mitigation complete for now. Next steps: Sam to revert policy, infra to update launch templates and test autoscaler, Alex to add richer autoscaler error alerting (iam failures), Rita to prepare customer post-incident notes. I'll attach a short incident handoff to the oncall rotation. :white_check_mark:
Alex (SRE): suggestions for postmortem: add explicit sanity check in CI that policies we roll out do not include iam:PassRole denies for node roles, and add an autoscaler metric for "LaunchFailures_IAM".
Sam (Infra): filed infra ticket #INF-1423 for LT reconciliation and policy PR. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Rita (MLOps): I'll send out customer comms draft in #customer-success for review.
Jordan (Oncall): closing thread after final confirm in 30m. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
